images.author: TenPoundHammer
images.caption: D&W Fresh Market of Petoskey, MI

brief: A 1990s single-storey supermarket: a long box of pale block and panels with a raised brick entrance pavilion carrying a lit logo sign, a car park with lamp standards. Two photos. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: a 1995 supermarket (Petoskey): a long one-storey EIFS box with a raised entry tower faced in stone veneer carrying the store sign, an arched canopy over the glass doors, a coffee chain's round sign; a big parking field with cart corrals and light poles

why.note: the supermarket: a plain box with an entry tower and sign (urban_layout/07)
